profile.summary: The USC Rossier School of Education is the education school of the University of Southern California, a private nonprofit university in Los Angeles. It prepares teachers and education leaders and does research and policy work aimed at educational equity, with a focus on urban and diverse communities.

review.notes: The agenda names USC Rossier School of Education exactly, a unique school of the University of Southern California, and an MOU for Talent/HR (staff and hiring) fits an education school's pipeline work. The Rossier about page confirms the phone, generic email, address, website and equity/urban-education mission, and ProPublica confirms the University of Southern California (EIN 95-1642394, Los Angeles, 501(c)(3)). No Oakland-specific source was found, but the exact name match leaves no competing organization.
